page_title: AskYourDatabase: Chat with Your SQL Database Using AI

summary.name: AskYourDatabase
summary.one_liner: An AI database chatbot and SQL assistant that lets you ask natural-language questions about a connected database and get generated SQL, results, and charts.
keywords: ask data questions in plain english
use_cases: Ask questions about business data without writing SQL
Generate SQL queries and charts from plain-English questions
Add a database chat interface to a website or product
Explore reporting data from PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Snowflake
Run private deployments inside an enterprise network
summary.what_it_does: AskYourDatabase connects to supported databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, BigQuery, Snowflake, Oracle, MongoDB, and ClickHouse. Users ask questions in natural language and receive generated SQL, query results, and charts. It is offered as a Desktop app for Windows or macOS for local analysis, and as a Website Chatbot for embedding database chat into a website or product. Schema descriptions, business terminology, and verified question-and-SQL examples are used to add context for unfamiliar tables. The page says Desktop keeps database credentials on the local computer, while the hosted Website Chatbot stores encrypted credentials and conversation records. Enterprise private deployment is mentioned.
notable: Desktop app and hosted Website Chatbot with separate plans
Supports many databases including BigQuery, Snowflake, and MongoDB
Uses verified question-and-SQL examples and schema descriptions for context
caveats: AI-generated queries and answers can be wrong; results should be checked against a trusted report
Self-hosting the app does not necessarily keep the language model in-house; model API calls may go to an external provider
Connection requirements and query syntax differ by database engine; pricing plans are not specified on the page
